query: What SOP training, operator competency checks, and inter‑rater reliability targets (kappa or ICC) will be required before data collection, and what instrument QC pass/fail rules will halt acquisition?

response.query: What SOP training, operator competency checks, and inter‑rater reliability targets (kappa or ICC) will be required before data collection, and what instrument QC pass/fail rules will halt acquisition?
response.answer: SOP training and operator competency checks must achieve 90% inter-rater reliability (ICC) before data collection. Instrument QC must pass with 100% accuracy; failure halts acquisition.
